scoring_justification: Only a single reported band gap value is produced; no raw band structure data for recomputation. Using T0 with hidden tolerance.

outputs.description: Band gap of Re3GeAs6 computed using DFT-LDA.

output_contract.notes: The band gap value is compared to the paper's LMTO-LDA band gap with a hidden tolerance to account for implementation differences.
